rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gitoid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Gitoid](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/prov/gitoid), stands for [Git Object ID](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Internals-Git-Objects). A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: ("Track\*" in the SSVC spec) The vulnerability contains specific characteristics that may require closer monitoring for changes. CISA recommends remediating Track\* vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.
Specifies the type of the external identifier.
Energy consumed when finetuning the AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gln
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Location Number (GLN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gln) is a 13-digit number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a legal entity (e.g., a company or customer), a function within a legal entity, a physical location (e.g., a warehouse or a specific shelf in a store), or a digital location (e.g., an Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) gateway).
Links a vulnerability and elements representing products (in the VEX sense) where a fix has been applied and are no longer affected.
Provides the location of an exploit catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ai
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the AI profile specification.
Links a vulnerability and one or more elements designating the latter as products not affected by the vulnerability.
A license that is listed on the SPDX License List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityFix
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the patch or source code that fixes a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOutput
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Build/Build, DefinedProcess or Action element generates each `to` Element as an output.
The amount or measure of a bulk product.
Specifies the algorithm used for calculating the hash value.
Specifies whether an additional text identifier has been marked as deprecated.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: certificationReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a certification report for a package from an accredited/independent body.
An assertion made in relation to one or more elements.
Specifies an Extension characterization of some aspect of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: notAutomated
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 0 - Not automated. No automation. The operator fully controls the system.
Specifies the SSVC decision type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: validatedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been validated on the `to` Element(s).
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.
Provides additional purpose information of the software artifact.
Link to the project contract.
A buildId is a locally unique identifier used by a builder to identify a unique instance of a build produced by it.
The length along the y-axis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: urlScheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) Schemes](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/uri-schemes.xhtml). The scheme used in order to locate a resource.
A product specification (product spec) is a detailed document that outlines the technical, functional, and design requirements of a product.
Reproduction is the biological process by which living organisms produce offspring.
Provides the location of an external reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The software is not affected because the vulnerable component is not in the product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: platform
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents a runtime environment.
The AssemblyProcess represents the process of creating a product by assembling a set of components, potentially in a way that allows for at disassembly (at least partially).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dalB
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Design Assurance Level B for aviation software assurance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to store extra information about an Element which is not part of a review (e.g. extra information provided during the creation of the Element).
A license expression participating in a license set.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: invokedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element was invoked by the `to` Agent, during a LifecycleScopeType period (for example, a /Build/Build element that describes a build step).
An SPDX version 2.X compatible verification method for software packages.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalComponent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is an optional component of the `from` Element (`from` hasOptionalComponent `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altWebPage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative web page.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The product is not affected because the code underlying the vulnerability is not present in the product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other relevant type of proof or documentation not covered above.
Provides information about the primary purpose of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kev
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerability (KEV) catalog.
Provides advise on how to mitigate or remediate a vulnerability when a VEX product is affected by it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.
The DefinedType class associates a specific type with its defined source.
Identifies the tooling that was used during the creation of the Element.
Information related to virtual hardware simulation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rorid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.
An Element an annotator has made an assertion about.
Energy consumption incurred by an AI model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: extension
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Extension profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publishedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was made available for public use or reference by each `to` Agent.
EvaluationResult is the result of an evaluation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element expands out as an artifact described by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: framework
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software framework.
Specifies the CVSS qualitative severity rating of a vulnerability in relation to a piece of software.
The valid state for StateProcess.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: patch
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element contains a set of changes to update, fix, or improve another Element.
Information about the type of contact point for `ContactPointRelationship`s.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: modifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is modified by each `to` Element.
A location where a package or an item is being picked up.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resolved
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` /SupplyChain/OutOfSpecAction is resolved in the `from` /SupplyChain/ResolutionAction.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDependencyManifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has manifest files that contain dependency information in each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability has been fixed by the `to` Agent(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analyzed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through analysis of artifacts (e.g., executables, packages, containers, and virtual machine images) after its build. Such analysis generally requires a variety of heuristics. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as a "3rd party" SBOM.
Provides an indication of where to retrieve an external Element.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/ElementCollection is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT-BIC or SWIFT code, is a unique 8 or 11-character alphanumeric code standardized by [ISO 9362](https://www.iso.org/standard/84108.html) to identify financial and non-financial institutions (e.g., `BBWCUS33`).
A license addition that is not listed on the SPDX Exceptions List.
Identifier for product production batch.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDeletedFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a file deleted from the `from` Element (`from` hasDeletedFile `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conformsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element conforms to each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption or Specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: limitedSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and there is limited support available from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is no support for the artifact from the supplier, consumer assumes any support obligations.
Provides a CVSS version 4 assessment for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory is defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityDisclosureReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Disclosure Report (VDR) which provides the software supplier's analysis and findings describing the impact (or lack of impact) that reported vulnerabilities have on packages or products in the supplier's SBOM as defined in [NIST SP 800-161 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices for Systems and Organizations](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/161/r1/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is not publicly available and an email registration is required before accessing the dataset, although without an affirmative acceptance of terms.
Defines the original host file that the snippet information applies to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: asilA
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Automotive Safety Integrity Level A under ISO 26262.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: autonomous
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 6 - Autonomous. The system is capable of modifying its intended domain of use or its goals without external intervention, control or oversight.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Makes no assertion about the field.
Specifies the exploit catalog type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crystalsKyber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Kyber](https://pq-crystals.org/kyber/)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hardware
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Hardware profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vcs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a version control system related to a software artifact.
An inspection action refers to a specific activity or set of activities performed during an inspection to examine, verify, or evaluate an item, process, or system.
A concrete subclass of Element used by Individuals in the Core profile.
Connects a vulnerability and an element designating the element as a product affected by the vulnerability.
A reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content related to an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasVariant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a variant the `from` Element (`from` hasVariant `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssessmentFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability and each `to` Element with a security assessment. The use of the `hasAssessmentFor` type is constrained to `/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exportControlAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an export control assessment for a package.
Availability of dataset.
Provides the result of an export control assessment.
An SPDX Element containing an SPDX license expression string.
Identifies all the text and metadata associated with a license in the license XML format.
A prescribed change to a product's location.
verificationMethod refers to the specific approach used for a checking an element's conformance with its requirements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) statement which provides information on whether a product is impacted by a specific vulnerability in an included package and, if affected, whether there are actions recommended to remediate. See also [NTIA VEX one-page summary](https://ntia.gov/files/ntia/publications/vex_one-page_summary.pdf).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contains
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element contains each `to` Element.
Identifies the size of a software Artifact, in bytes.
A collection of Elements that have a shared context.
Provides a NamespaceMap of prefixes and associated namespace partial URIs applicable to an SpdxDocument and independent of any specific serialization format or instance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mailingList
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the mailing list used by the maintainer for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a single file (default).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when someone reviews the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: availableFrom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is available from the additional supplier described by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: documentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is documentation.
Location is used to define the location, address or coordinates of a place.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sourceArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an artifact containing the sources for a package.
An Individual Value for License where the SPDX data creator determines that no license is present.
Identifies a functional safety integrity level associated with a relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidenceUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a reporting management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify an evidence relationship item.
This is the agent that performed the act of destroying the item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dynamicAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a dynamic analysis report for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other safety integrity level not covered above.
A QUDT (Quantity, Unit, Dimension and Type) unit applied to measurement criteria based on product type, region, and use.
RoleRelationship represents a relationship between an entity holding a role and the scope or context in which that role applies. The givenRole property specifies the role assigned.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amendedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is amended by each `to` Element.
Specifies the SPDX License List version in which this ListedLicense or ListedLicenseException identifier was first added.
Identifies the name of an Element as designated by the creator.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: delegatedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent is delegating an action to the Agent of the `to` Relationship (which shall be of type invokedBy), during a LifecycleScopeType period (e.g. the `to` invokedBy Relationship is being done on behalf of `from`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact is in active development and is not considered ready for formal support from the supplier.
An individual human being.
Threshold that was used for computation of a metric described in the metric field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: qualityAssessmentReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a quality assessment for a package.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.
Inspection Process defines specific various processes needed to satisfy the inspection requirements for a specific product or service.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packagedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a packaged instance of the `from` Element (`from` packagedBy `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: phoneNumber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Phone number; A string of decimal digits that uniquely indicates the network termination point defined in [RFC 3966](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3966/) Section 5.
Energy consumed when training the AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fullAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 5 - Full automation. The system is capable of performing its entire mission without external intervention.
A license exception that is listed on the SPDX Exceptions list.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/ExpandedLicensing/License is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This process is used to determine the state of an affected Element.
Describes a sensor used for collecting the data.
Specifies whether the License is listed as approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
Type of data in a dataset.
Information about the AI software, not including the model description.
Records the storage of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altDownloadLocation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative download location.
References an Element on the right-hand side of a relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDataFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element treats each `to` Element as a data file. A data file is an artifact that stores data required or optional for the `from` Element's functionality. The `hasDataFile` relationship does not imply a dependency. Examples of data files include database files, index files, log files, AI model files, calibration data files, temporary files, and backup files. For configuration data, build input data, build output data, test artifacts, test datasets, and training datasets, the more specific relationship types `configures`, `hasInput`, `hasOutput`, `hasTest`, `testedOn`, and `trainedOn` shall be used, respectively.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: duns
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Data Universal Numbering System (D-U-N-S) Number](https://www.dnb.com/en-us/smb/duns.html) is a unique nine-digit identifier, issued by Dun & Bradstreet, that identifies a business entity, often on a location-specific basis.
City is a specific name used to define a locality.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iswc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)](https://www.iswc.org/iswc) is an 11-character unique identifier standardized by [ISO 15707](https://www.iso.org/standard/83125.html) for musical works (compositions) as distinct from specific recordings. While the "ISWC" label and grouping separators (dots and hyphens) are used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `T0017812031`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: diskImage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a disk image that can be written to a disk, booted in a VM, etc. A disk image typically contains most or all of the components necessary to boot, such as bootloaders, kernels, firmware, userspace, etc.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other specialized or custom verification method that fits the context.
A License participating in a 'with addition' model.
Categories of presence or absence.
Authorization specifies the permissions, rights, privileges, or benefits granted to a Role, defining what the role is authorized to access, perform, or receive.
Methods that can be used to explain the results from the AI model.
A known location is specified at this time.
Information about different steps of the training process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: providesSupportFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent provides support for each `to` Artifact. The use of the `providesSupportFor` type is constrained to `SupportRelationship` classed relationships.
Text specifying a province or state.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hsCodes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Harmonized System (HS)](https://www.wcoomd.org/en/topics/nomenclature/overview/what-is-the-harmonized-system.aspx) of tariff nomenclature is an internationally standardized system of names and numbers, defined by the World Customs Organization, used to classify traded products.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through instrumenting the system running the software, to capture only components present in the system, as well as external call-outs or dynamically loaded components. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as an "Instrumented" or "Dynamic" SBOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasConcludedLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact is concluded by the SPDX data creator to be governed by each `to` /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo. If the `to` of an Artifact's `hasConcludedLicense` is not the same as the `to` of its `hasDeclaredLicense`, a written explanation should be provided in the comment field of the `hasConcludedLicense` relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: asilC
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Automotive Safety Integrity Level C under ISO 26262.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: filesystemImage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a file system image that can be written to a disk (or virtual) partition.
A code that identifies a county.
A planned path used to move people, goods, data, or resources from one location to another.
This is the state of an affected Element.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [customIdToLicense](./customIdToLicense.md) instead.
Maps a "LicenseRef-" string for a custom license or a "AdditionRef-" string for a custom license addition to its URI identifier.
**NOTE:** This property is deprecated and only included for backward compatibility. New documents should use [customIdToLicense](./customIdToLicense.md) instead.
Specifies the type of the content identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conditionalAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 3 - Conditional automation. The system can propose strategies and then automatically execute the approved plan, with an external agent being ready to take over when necessary.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasProvidedDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a dependency on each `to` Element, dependency is not in the distributed artifact, but assumed to be provided, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
A substitute for a URI.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: usesTool
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element uses each `to` Element as a tool, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Specifies a country code where a software service is hosted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iscc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Content Code (ISCC)](https://iscc.io/) is a content-derived identifier standardized by [ISO 24138](https://www.iso.org/standard/77899.html) for identifying digital assets. ISCC can be used in conjunction with other schemes, such as DOI, ISAN, ISBN, ISRC, ISSN and ISWC. A standard ISCC-CODE is build from multiple ISCC-UNITs. Each unit serve a different purpose. An ISCC-CODE typically look like `ISCC:KACT4EBWK27737D2AYCJRAL5Z36G76RFRMO4554RU26HZ4ORJGIVHDI`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: falcon
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [FALCON](https://falcon-sign.info/falcon.pdf)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: custody
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Custody refers to the responsibility, control, and safekeeping of an asset, person, or legal entity. It involves both physical possession and legal accountability over something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A systematic examination of a system, process, or outcome to evaluate compliance of specific work products with a specific expectation with a specification, regulation or standard. Often involves judgement and a rationale of this judgement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: asilB
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Automotive Safety Integrity Level B under ISO 26262.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: formalStandard
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A formal standard is a standard ratified by a recognized standards-development organization and published as a normative reference.
Describes the type of annotation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assistiveAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 1 - Assistive automation. The system assists an operator.
Class that describes an action that has occurred.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: none
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is 0.0.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRequirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a requirement on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dalA
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Design Assurance Level A for aviation software assurance.
A set of geographic point location coordinates.
Location of a specific action.
Evaluation is an outcome considering results of a verification.
An out of specification action is defined in this class.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when there is a security related identifier of unspecified type.
Indicates whether a relationship is known to be complete, incomplete, or if no assertion is made with respect to relationship completeness.
Indicates the specific RequirementVerification instance on which the EvaluationResult is based.
An Agent responsible for product identification, such as an original equipment manufacturer (OEM).
Date of product release.
A tuple of two positive integers that define a range.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: low
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Low/no risk is posed by an AI system.
Specifies the type of a content identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doi
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Digital Object Identifier (DOI)](https://www.doi.org/the-identifier/what-is-a-doi/) is a unique, [ISO 26324](https://www.iso.org/standard/88862.html)-standardized identifier for physical, digital, or abstract objects, formatted as a prefix and suffix separated by a forward slash (e.g., `10.1000/182`).
Specifies the type of simulation model used to represent virtual hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: security
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Security profile specification.
Provides information about the creation of the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: act
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level and leadership-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, as well as publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. Typically, internal groups would meet to determine the overall response and then execute agreed upon actions. CISA recommends remediating Act vulnerabilities as soon as possible.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: categorical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data that is classified into a discrete number of categories, such as the eye color of a population of people.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to funding information related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha1
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-1, a secure hashing algorithm, as defined in [RFC 3174](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3174/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: retired
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement is no longer active for a specific use.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assumes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element assumes each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption.
A value used in a generic key-value pair.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 4.0 - 6.9.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other exploit catalogs.
The assessment of the state of a requirement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: report
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Structured documentation of test results, inspections, or analyses.
Provides a reference number that can be used to understand how to parse and interpret an Element.
A mathematical algorithm that maps data of arbitrary size to a bit string.
Anonymization methods used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: update
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications for a product update.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is metadata about the `from` Element (`from` hasMetadata `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
